title: Moroccan Tagine Chicken
description: A traditional North African stew made with chicken, spices, and dried fruits, slow-cooked in a clay pot.

ingredients.name: tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern grocery stores

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the spice mix, apricots, prunes, broth, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Stir in the flour to thicken the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
